Wanted.description: Holds items waiting for their release time. An item moves to Scraping once its release date plus the airtime offset has passed (Movie Airtime Offset, default 19 hours, counted from the end of release day for movies with no airtime; Episode Airtime Offset, default 0). Items that are more than 24 hours away, or have no release date, go to Unreleased. Versions that require a physical release wait for the physical release date. Early-release and magnet-assigned items move right away. Wanted stops feeding Scraping while Scraping already holds 100 items.
Wanted.action: Check every Wanted item's release time and move the ready ones to Scraping.

Scraping.description: Runs your enabled scrapers for each item, filters and scores the results with the item's version settings, and passes the best ones to Adding. When several episodes of a show are wanted at once, it tries season and series packs first. If nothing is found: movies released more than 30 days ago, episodes released more than 7 days ago, and items with no release date are blacklisted right away (an old episode also blacklists the other old episodes from its season). Newer items go to Sleeping until the wake limit is used up.
Scraping.action: Scrape the items in the Scraping queue.

Adding.description: Adds the best scrape result to your debrid service or usenet provider, trying the next result if one fails. For debrid torrents, Uncached Content Handling decides what's allowed: None takes only cached results, Full takes the best result cached or not, Hybrid tries cached first and then uncached. Accept Uncached Within Hours lets recent releases use uncached torrents too. Usenet NZBs are submitted and wait here while the NZB Health Check task watches the download. Items move to Checking once added, or to Blacklisted if every result fails.
Adding.action: Add the items in the Adding queue to debrid or usenet.

Checking.description: Waits for an added file to show up, then marks the item Collected. In Symlinked/Local mode, once the file appears on the mount it creates the symlink, tells Plex or Jellyfin/Emby to scan it if one is set up, and runs post-processing. In Plex mode it waits until Plex has the file (or, with Disable Plex Library Checks, until the file is on the mount). Items that never show up go back to Wanted after the Checking Queue Period (Debug settings, default 1 hour). A torrent the provider reports missing several times in a row has its magnet blacklisted.
Checking.action: Look for the files of the items in the Checking queue.
Checking.runs: Always on, except in Plex mode with library checks disabled and no mounted file location (then Check Plex Files does this work).

Sleeping.description: Items that weren't found while scraping rest here, then go back to Wanted for another try. By default that's every 30 minutes (Sleep Duration Minutes, minimum 10), up to 24 tries (Wake Limit). A version can set its own wake count, and -1 skips sleeping. After the last try the item goes to Final Scrape if it's enabled, otherwise to Blacklisted. Only recent items sleep. Older ones are blacklisted straight from Scraping.
Sleeping.action: Wake the items whose sleep time is up, and blacklist the ones out of tries.

Unreleased.description: Holds items whose release date is more than 24 hours away or still unknown. Each run recalculates the release time the same way Wanted does (airtime offset, physical release date for versions that need it) and moves items to Wanted once they're within 24 hours.
Unreleased.action: Move Unreleased items that are now within 24 hours of release to Wanted.

Blacklisted.description: Holds items that couldn't be found or added. Unblacklisting is off by default (Debug → Disable Unblacklisting). When you turn it on, items that have been blacklisted for longer than Blacklist Duration (default 30 days) go back to Wanted for another try. Unblacklisting Cutoff Date limits this to items released on or after that date.
Blacklisted.action: Unblacklist the items that qualify. Does nothing while unblacklisting is disabled.

Pending Uncached.description: Uncached torrents wait here while your debrid account is at its active-download limit. Each run checks the limit and, when there's room, adds the waiting torrents and moves them on.
Pending Uncached.action: Add the waiting uncached torrents if the debrid account has room.

Upgrading.description: With Enable Upgrading on, items collected within 7 days of release stay here for 24 hours (Upgrade Queue Duration Hours, Debug settings) and are re-scraped about once an hour. A result that beats the current file by the upgrade threshold is added and replaces it. The old file is removed only if Enable Upgrading Cleanup is on. When the window ends, the item becomes Collected. Manually assigned items never upgrade. Upgrades queued from the Upgrade Hub also run here.
Upgrading.action: Re-scrape the Upgrading items that are due and finish the ones whose window has ended.
Upgrading.runs: Always on. Items only enter it when Enable Upgrading is on.

final_check_queue.description: Only used when Blacklist Final Scrape Delay Hours is above 0. Items that would be blacklisted wait here for that many hours and then get one last scrape. If it finds something, the item goes to Adding. If not, it's blacklisted. If you set the delay back to 0, items still waiting here are blacklisted.
final_check_queue.action: Do the final scrape for the items whose delay has passed.
final_check_queue.runs: Always on. Items only enter it when the delay setting is above 0.

Pre_release.description: Only used when Pre-Release Scrape Days is above 0. Unreleased movies coming out within that many days are scraped once a day in case a release appears early. A usable result is added right away. Otherwise the movie stays Unreleased. Within 24 hours of release, the movie leaves this queue and follows the normal Wanted flow.
Pre_release.action: Run the daily scrape for the pre-release movies.
Pre_release.runs: Always on. Does nothing while Pre-Release Scrape Days is 0.

task_nzb_health_check.description: Watches the NZB downloads of usenet items in the Adding queue. When a job finishes and its folder appears on the mount, the item moves to Checking. Jobs that fail, vanish, or run past the download timeout are removed, and the item goes back to Wanted with that release marked not wanted. Polls up to 30 jobs per run, and skips a run if the previous one was slow.
task_nzb_health_check.action: Check the status of the pending NZB jobs.
task_nzb_health_check.runs: Always on. Does nothing unless usenet items are in Adding.

task_nzb_playback_repair_completion.description: Finishes NZB playback repairs that have already started. When a usenet file fails to play (missing segments, unreadable video), a replacement is grabbed. This task confirms the replacement is healthy, switches the library to it, and removes the broken file. It never looks for new broken files.
task_nzb_playback_repair_completion.action: Confirm and finish the in-progress playback repairs.

task_nzb_playback_cleanup_retry.description: Some playback repairs finish before the old broken file can be removed, usually because the mount hasn't caught up yet. This task retries those removals on a slower schedule (15 minutes up to 2 hours apart) and gives up after 48 hours.
task_nzb_playback_cleanup_retry.action: Retry the old-file removals left over from finished playback repairs.

task_repair_broken_nzbs.description: Asks the usenet provider (cli_mount) for a health scan, then repairs the NZB files it reports as broken. For each one it blacklists the broken release and scrapes for a usenet replacement. The old file is only deleted after the replacement is confirmed in the provider's queue. If no replacement is found, the broken file stays in place, the item goes back to Wanted, and the repair tries again later (1, 2, 4 hours apart, up to 24 hours). Auto-repair gives up on an item after 3 failed attempts.
task_repair_broken_nzbs.action: Run a health scan and repair the broken NZBs.
task_repair_broken_nzbs.runs: On by default. Needs cli_mount as the usenet provider.

task_repair_broken_debrids.description: Asks cli_mount for a health scan of its debrid torrents and repairs the broken ones. A torrent missing its provider link is re-inserted. Otherwise, only the item whose file is broken goes back to Wanted, and the torrent is deleted only when no other item (for example the rest of a season pack) still uses it. Leftover health records with nothing behind them are cleaned up first.
task_repair_broken_debrids.action: Run a health scan and repair the broken debrid torrents.

task_sync_cli_mount_changes.description: Pulls changes from cli_mount (renamed folders, new provider IDs, magnets, file names) into the cli_debrid database so both agree on where each file lives. The first run does a full sync and pauses the queue until it's done.
task_sync_cli_mount_changes.action: Fetch the changes from cli_mount since the last sync.
task_sync_cli_mount_changes.runs: On by default. Does nothing unless cli_mount is set up.

task_push_pending_climount_tags.description: Sends tags you changed in cli_debrid (for example with Database → Assign Tags) to cli_mount. Sync cli_mount Changes only brings changes the other way, so without this a tag edited only in cli_debrid would never reach cli_mount.
task_push_pending_climount_tags.action: Push the changed tags to cli_mount.
task_push_pending_climount_tags.runs: On by default. Does nothing unless cli_mount is set up.

task_scan_mount_for_external_adds.description: Imports content that showed up on the debrid mount without cli_debrid putting it there, such as torrents added through DMM or the provider's website. New folders go through the same symlink pipeline as Zurg's library-update webhook. The first run only records what's already on the mount, so turning this on doesn't import your whole existing library. Leftovers from cli_debrid's own rejected grabs are skipped.
task_scan_mount_for_external_adds.action: Scan the mount and import new external content.
task_scan_mount_for_external_adds.runs: Symlinked/Local mode only, when File Management → Scan Mount for External Adds is on. Zurg users don't need it.

task_backfill_nzb_torrent_ids.description: One-time fix for older usenet items that were collected without a provider ID. Matches each item's folder name against cli_mount's entries and saves the ID, so repair and sync can find those items.
task_backfill_nzb_torrent_ids.action: Fill in the missing provider IDs from cli_mount.
task_backfill_nzb_torrent_ids.runs: Off by default. Run it once. Needs cli_mount as the usenet provider.

task_check_service_connectivity.description: Checks that the services cli_debrid depends on are reachable: your debrid service or usenet provider, Plex or Jellyfin/Emby, and the mount and symlink folders in Symlinked/Local mode. If one is down, the queue pauses and resumes on its own once it's back. If Trakt is set up, its login is checked and refreshed too, but a Trakt problem never pauses the queue.
task_check_service_connectivity.action: Check every required service and pause or resume the queue.

task_heartbeat.description: Writes a "Program running..." line to the log, then frees unused memory and logs memory use before and after. Useful for seeing that the program is alive and how much memory it uses over time.
task_heartbeat.action: Log a heartbeat and free unused memory.

task_trim_memory.description: Frees memory that large one-off jobs (Upgrade Hub scans, the Debrid Manager library, overlay syncs) leave behind, so memory use stays flat over long uptimes. Also drops the Debrid Manager library cache after 2 hours without use.
task_trim_memory.action: Free unused memory and log how much was released.

task_regulate_system_load.description: Watches CPU and RAM use. Above the thresholds (System Load Regulation settings, default 75%), it adds a pause between queue tasks and makes it longer each run, up to the maximum. Once load drops, the pause shrinks again.
task_regulate_system_load.action: Check system load and adjust the pause between tasks.
task_regulate_system_load.runs: Off by default, except in limited environments.

task_update_queue_views.description: Reloads every queue from the database so the Queues page and the queue processors see changes made elsewhere, such as from the web UI or another task.
task_update_queue_views.action: Refresh all queues from the database.

task_send_notifications.description: Sends the queued notifications (collected, upgraded, state changes...) to the notification services you've enabled.
task_send_notifications.runs: Always on. Does nothing if no notifications are queued.

task_check_database_health.description: Checks that media_items.db is readable and not corrupt. If it's corrupt, the queue pauses and a notification is sent, because the program needs a restart to rebuild the database.

task_backup_database.description: Copies cli_mount's databases every run. Backs up media_items.db only when the program is idle, so the database isn't locked during busy processing.

task_sync_time.description: Compares the system clock with internet time servers (pool.ntp.org, Cloudflare, Google) and logs a warning if it's more than 60 seconds off. It doesn't change the clock. A wrong clock can make release times and logins misbehave.
task_sync_time.action: Check the clock and log the offset.

task_reconcile_queues.description: Cleans up the queues. Items in Checking that point to the same file as another item are merged. After a Replace Season/Movie, the old entries are removed once the new ones are collected. Season-pack episodes left in Adding after a sibling was collected are matched to their own files. Duplicate Wanted, Scraping and Unreleased items are removed, and so are ones whose version is already collected. Details go to reconciliations.log.
task_reconcile_queues.runs: Always on. Also runs after each Plex full scan.

task_refresh_download_stats.description: Refreshes the download stats shown on the home page, so the page loads without waiting on them.
task_refresh_download_stats.action: Refresh the home page download stats.

task_refresh_library_size_cache.description: Asks your debrid service for the total size of your library and saves it for the home page. Skipped for services that don't report a total size.
task_refresh_library_size_cache.action: Fetch and save the debrid library size.

task_precompute_airing_shows.description: Builds the "recently aired" and "airing soon" lists in the background so the home page shows them right away.

task_check_trakt_early_releases.description: For movies in Wanted, Sleeping or Unreleased, checks Trakt's popular lists for each title. If it appears on a "latest releases" or "new releases" list, the movie is flagged as an early release and scraped right away instead of waiting for its release date. Episodes and movies marked "no early release" are skipped.
task_check_trakt_early_releases.action: Check Trakt lists and flag early movie releases.
task_check_trakt_early_releases.runs: On by default. Does nothing unless Scraping → Trakt Early Releases is on and Trakt is set up.

task_refresh_plex_tokens.description: Checks with plex.tv that your main Plex token and the tokens of other users' Plex watchlists are still valid, and logs any that aren't. If a watchlist stops updating, look here for an invalid token.

task_plex_full_scan.description: Reads your whole Plex library and records everything in it as Collected, filling in missing resolutions from the file names. Then runs Reconcile Queues so items already in Plex leave Wanted.
task_plex_full_scan.action: Run a full Plex library scan.
task_plex_full_scan.runs: Plex mode only, unless you turn it on by hand.

task_manual_plex_full_scan.description: The same full Plex library scan as Plex Full Scan, but runs in any mode. Meant for libraries that mix symlinks with files Plex already has.
task_manual_plex_full_scan.action: Run a full Plex library scan regardless of mode.

task_check_plex_files.description: In Plex mode, looks on the mount for the files of items in Checking. When one appears, it asks Plex to scan just that folder, so new files show up fast instead of waiting for Plex's own scan. With Disable Plex Library Checks on, items are marked Collected as soon as the file is on the mount, or right away if no mounted file location is set. Also fixes upgraded items whose saved location still points to the old file.
task_check_plex_files.action: Look for new files on the mount and trigger Plex scans.
task_check_plex_files.runs: Plex mode, when Update Plex on File Discovery or Disable Plex Library Checks is on.

task_verify_symlinked_files.description: Confirms that new symlinks actually showed up in Plex or Jellyfin/Emby. Alternates between checking recently added items and a full check, up to 500 files per run. Files that still don't appear after several tries are marked as failed.
task_verify_symlinked_files.action: Check that the new symlinks are in the media server.
task_verify_symlinked_files.runs: Symlinked/Local mode, when a Plex or Jellyfin/Emby server is set up for symlinks.

task_verify_plex_removals.description: After cli_debrid removes a file, checks that its title is gone from Plex. Items still listed get more tries with growing waits (1 minute up to 30 minutes) and are marked failed after the max attempts (Plex Removal Max Attempts, default 5).
task_verify_plex_removals.action: Check that removed files are gone from Plex.
task_verify_plex_removals.runs: On by default. Does nothing without a Plex server set up.

task_process_standalone_plex_removals.description: Some removals are delayed on purpose. For example, Library Maintenance and Analyze Media Files queue Plex removals instead of doing them right away. Once a removal has waited long enough (Plex Removal Cache Delay Minutes, Debug settings, default 6 hours), this task deletes the symlink if one is left and removes the item from Plex. A removal is skipped if the item has come back into the library in the meantime.
task_process_standalone_plex_removals.action: Carry out the delayed Plex removals.

task_get_plex_watch_history.description: Downloads your Plex watch history so items you've already watched aren't added to the queue again.
task_get_plex_watch_history.runs: Only when Debug → Don't Add Plex Watch History Items to Queue is on.

task_run_library_maintenance.description: Checks the library against the files on disk. In Symlinked/Local mode it finds broken symlinks (target missing) and orphaned symlinks the database doesn't know about. In Plex mode it checks that collected files are still on the mount. Broken items go back to Wanted if they were the last copy of their version, otherwise they're deleted, and their Plex entries are queued for removal.
task_run_library_maintenance.action: Run library maintenance and fix what it finds.
task_run_library_maintenance.runs: Off by default. On in limited environments or when Debug → Enable Library Maintenance Task is on.

task_analyze_media_files.description: Opens collected files with ffprobe to make sure they can be played, 200 files per run, picking up where the last run stopped. Unplayable files are removed: the symlink is deleted, the Plex entry is queued for removal, and the item goes back to Wanted if it was the last copy of its version. Otherwise the item is deleted.
task_analyze_media_files.action: Check the next 200 files with ffprobe.

task_sync_library_metadata.description: Reads the audio and subtitle tracks of collected items from Plex or Jellyfin and saves them. Overlays and audio-language checks use this information.
task_sync_library_metadata.action: Sync the audio and subtitle track details from the media server.
task_sync_library_metadata.runs: On by default. Does nothing without a media server set up.

task_backfill_plex_guids.description: One-time fix that fills in the Plex GUID for collected movies and shows that don't have one, from the metadata battery (with a Trakt lookup as fallback). Features that match items with Plex, like labels and collections, need the GUID.
task_backfill_plex_guids.action: Fill in the missing Plex GUIDs.
task_backfill_plex_guids.runs: Off by default. Run it once.

task_backfill_plex_ms_item_id.description: One-time fix for collected items that don't have a saved Plex item ID. First asks Plex to scan each item's folder, then looks the items up in Plex by file name and GUID. If Plex is still scanning when the lookup runs, run it again later to catch the rest.
task_backfill_plex_ms_item_id.action: Trigger Plex scans and fill in the missing Plex item IDs.
task_backfill_plex_ms_item_id.runs: Off by default. Run it once. Needs Plex.

task_refresh_release_dates.description: Looks up the release dates of items that aren't collected yet (Unreleased, Wanted, Sleeping, Final Scrape) again, so changed or newly announced dates are picked up.

task_sync_episode_metadata.description: For every collected show, fetches the episode list again and updates changed episode titles and airtimes, plus missing release dates. Useful when titles were missing or wrong when the episodes were collected.
task_sync_episode_metadata.action: Sync episode titles and air dates.

task_update_show_ids.description: Checks the IMDb and TMDB IDs of shows in the database against current metadata and fixes ones that changed. Rarely needed.

task_update_show_titles.description: Updates show titles in the database to match current metadata. The old title is kept as an alias so scraping still matches releases that use it. Rarely needed.

task_update_movie_ids.description: Checks the IMDb and TMDB IDs of movies in the database against current metadata and fixes ones that changed. Rarely needed.

task_update_movie_titles.description: Updates movie titles in the database to match current metadata. The old title is kept as an alias so scraping still matches releases that use it. Rarely needed.

task_update_tv_show_status.description: Updates each show's status (returning, ended...) from metadata and works out, for each version, whether you have every episode of the show.
task_update_tv_show_status.action: Update show statuses and per-version completion.

task_cleanup_title_year_suffixes.description: Removes a year in brackets from the end of titles in the database, for example "The Office (2005)" becomes "The Office". Titles with the year attached don't match releases properly.

task_overlay_sync.description: Checks collected items for changes that affect their poster overlays and redraws only the posters whose content or layout changed since they were last applied.

task_overlay_cleanup.description: Deletes saved original-poster backups for items that are no longer tracked, and resets overlay jobs stuck in "analyzing" for over 30 minutes so they run again.

task_sync_plex_labels.description: Adds Plex labels to collected items based on their content source, up to 100 per run. Catches labels that couldn't be added when the item was collected because Plex didn't have it yet. Labels can be used for Plex filters and smart collections.
task_sync_plex_labels.runs: Off by default. Does nothing unless a content source has Plex labels enabled.

task_sync_viewer_history.description: Downloads what every Plex account and Emby/Jellyfin user has watched on your servers (last 2 years), so Discover → Recommendations can show suggestions for each person.
task_sync_viewer_history.runs: Every 6 hours when Plex or Emby/Jellyfin and a TMDB key are set up (first run 5 minutes after startup). Can be turned off here.

task_process_plex_reported_issues.description: Checks every 30 seconds for issues reported with Plex's Report Issue on items in your library (Plex has no way to push them). A reported movie or episode is sent back to Wanted to get a different release, and the current file keeps playing until the new one is in. The reporter gets a reply in Plex when it's picked up and again once it's replaced. Reports on a whole show or season are only flagged for you.
task_process_plex_reported_issues.action: Check for new reported issues now.
task_process_plex_reported_issues.runs: When Plex Reported Issues is enabled in Additional Settings.

task_plex_smart_collection_posters.description: Applies your shared custom poster design to the Plex smart collections you've enabled for it.
task_plex_smart_collection_posters.runs: When Plex is the media server.

task_plex_movie_boxsets.description: Finds which TMDB collection (box set) each movie belongs to, creates or updates the matching Plex collections, and sets their posters. With Grab Missing on, it also adds the movies you're missing from each collection to Wanted. Only collections whose owned movies changed are rebuilt.
task_plex_movie_boxsets.action: Sync the movie box set collections in Plex.
task_plex_movie_boxsets.runs: When Plex is the media server. Does nothing unless Plex Movie Box Sets is enabled.

task_process_bulk_subtitles.description: Downloads subtitles for collected files that don't have any yet, up to 200 per run. Files that were already tried are skipped. Symlinked/Local mode saves .srt files next to the symlinks. Plex mode adds them through cli_mount.
task_process_bulk_subtitles.action: Download subtitles for the next 200 files.

task_backup_debrid.description: Saves a list of every torrent in your debrid account, so the library can be restored if the account is lost or wiped. Keeps three copies: 1, 3 and 7 days old.
task_backup_debrid.action: Back up the debrid torrent list.
task_backup_debrid.runs: Off by default. Does nothing unless debrid backup is enabled in its settings.

task_cleanup_debrid.description: Removes junk from your debrid account. Each rule can be turned on or off in the cleanup settings: errored torrents (error, magnet error, virus, dead), duplicates of the same torrent (keeps the best copy), and torrents stuck at 0% for too many days.
task_cleanup_debrid.action: Delete errored, duplicate and stalled debrid torrents.
task_cleanup_debrid.runs: Off by default. While this task is on, it runs even if the cleanup's own enable switch is off.

task_upgrade_hub_scan.description: Searches Zilean for better-quality releases of your collected items and saves the upgrade and season-pack candidates for the Upgrade Hub page. Scan Limit caps how many items are checked.

task_upgrade_hub_auto_queue.description: Takes the candidates from the last Upgrade Hub scan (and scans first if there are none) and queues the ones that meet the Min Improvement Threshold for upgrading, up to Max Upgrades per Run. Season packs come first, and items already upgrading are skipped. Show Recent Only limits it to recently added items.

content_source.description: Fetches the items from this content source (watchlist, list, request service...) and adds new ones to the Wanted queue for each version the source has enabled. Items already in the database are skipped. Item details are cached for 6 hours. The cache can be cleared on the Debug page.
content_source.runs: On while the content source is enabled.
